nodes.label: Admin 'Tambah Akreditasi Program Studi & Institusi' form (BAA panel, Tambah Data Akreditasi)
nodes.rationale: Admin-panel design mockup of the accreditation data-entry form: sidebar nav (Dasbor, Berita, Pengumuman, Kalender Akademik, Kurikulum, Dokumen Akademik, RPL, Akreditasi active, Buku, Buku Wisuda, Data Lulusan, Pimpinan & Staf, Unit, Profil Bidang), form fields for Unit/Program Studi (searchable select, S1 - Teknik Informatika), Fakultas (auto-locked to FSI from chosen program), Peringkat Akreditasi (Unggul with badge preview), Lembaga Akreditasi (LAM INFOKOM), Nomor SK Akreditasi, Tanggal Berlaku Mulai/Sampai with client-side inline validation error ('tanggal berlaku sampai harus setelah tanggal berlaku'), auto-calculated masa berlaku status (Aktif/Kedaluwarsa with 6-month expiry notification to Tim Penjaminan Mutu Prodi), drag-and-drop PDF certificate upload (max 5MB, PDF/A verification, ingest to quality-assurance repository), metadata footer (operator, PDDikti Feeder connection status, system timestamp), and reset/cancel/save actions. Rationale: single source of truth for accreditation validity feeding PDDikti synchronization and quality assurance recapitulation.
